about: The production LiteDRAM core (both DDR3 channels, DDR3-1066, CL7/CWL6, 512-bit native ports through LiteDRAM's ECC, a BIST per channel, CSRs on an AXI-Lite slave in ctl_clk) with WL7DDRPHY (docs/litedram.md section 8: per channel a WriteClocks MMCM cascaded from sys, the host shifting CK and the commands, the reads captured on the static write clocks; one write clock group; every serializer reset from its own register; per-bit read framing through ddrphy*_dly_sel_bits), with the calibration CPU (--selfcal, docs/litedram.md section 10: a VexRiscv that calibrates both channels at reset, its firmware tools/litedram/selfcal_fw built with riscv64-elf-gcc and inlined), generated by tools/litedram/gen_core.py; its csr.csv and sdram_init.py are opentpu/host/litedram/. Check or regenerate: tools/litedram/check_core.sh.

settings.generator_commit: litedram-int 8cbfd3b, wlrst max_delay 3.0 ns (ld-top); the calibration CPU, ld-cpu 4461c052; ld-fmax: the CSR bus a register stage per bank group (csr_pipe.py), sys's reset through a register after its synchronizer (WLCRG rst_reg), the ECC counters from registered flags
